note: The environment both suites read to reach a real warehouse. Held here so the two harnesses cannot drift on a variable name. Connection variables are the vendor's own, so one export block serves both languages and the vendor CLIs. Databricks credentials are left to the vendor's unified authentication, which resolves DATABRICKS_TOKEN, a DATABRICKS_CLIENT_ID with a secret or GitHub Actions OIDC, or a Databricks CLI login, so none is named here. Snowflake signs in with a key pair, the one method a service user and a person share. Fixture variables carry one dotted identifier each. A backend whose required variables are unset skips; an optional fixture skips only the tests that need it.

schema.description: Catalog and schema holding the provisioned tables, as `catalog.schema`. The table names themselves come from live-warehouse-rows.json.

denied_table.description: A relation the test principal genuinely cannot read. Provisioning with --grant-to creates one, owned by the principal that runs the SQL (on Snowflake, its active role).

parameterized_model.description: A metric view with at least one parameter and one metric. Read by the R suite only: pkg-py has no semantic-model surface (commons kata gcgj).

parameterized_model_arguments.description: The arguments to call the parameterized model with, as a JSON object. Needed alongside it.

schema.description: Database and schema holding the provisioned tables, as `database.schema`.

denied_table.description: A relation the test role genuinely cannot read.

alternate_role.description: A second usable role, for the active-role change test.

semantic_view.description: A semantic view. Read by the R suite only, as with the Databricks metric view.

verified_query_view.description: A semantic view carrying a verified query. Read by the R suite only.

parameterized_model.description: A semantic view with at least one variable and one metric. Read by the R suite only.

parameterized_model_arguments.description: The arguments to call the parameterized model with, as a JSON object. Needed alongside it.
